info.name: Autonomous AP APIs Chart of Accounts Tax Master API

items.docs: Creates a new tax master record in AppZen and returns a uuid that uniquely identifies it. When there is already exists a record (tax_id), then the operation is an update (the `status` would be `UPDATED` in this case).

params.name: uuid
params.description: Globally unique identifier for an uploaded document

items.docs: Returns the details of a Tax master item by uuid

info.name: Returns tax master item details by tax-id

items.docs: Returns Tax master item details matching tax-id specified as path parameter
